run.name: RUN
run.line: Bank the shuttle's charge and fly it out.
run.how: Carry power aft to the shuttle bay, bank {shuttle} of it, and launch. Launch holding {threshold} or more infection and you are the thing that gets off the ship.

burn.name: BURN
burn.line: Arm the reactor overload and live through the countdown.
burn.how: Arm the overload on the bridge for {power} power, then still be alive {fuse} hours later when it goes. The ship gets a little louder every one of those hours.

call.name: CALL
call.line: Broadcast what happened here and hold the transmitter until it lands.
call.how: Broadcast from comms, then hold it {hold} hours. It drains {drain} power an hour and it dies if anything gets into comms, so you will need the reactor up and the bulkheads down.

know.name: KNOW
know.line: Cut a specimen out of the nest and send the readings up.
know.how: Take the specimen from the ore hold, carry it to comms and upload it. It calls to them the whole way — every hour you hold it, the compartment you are in gets louder.

escaped.name: CLEAN BREAK
escaped.verdict: You are off the ship and nothing came with you.
escaped.how: Bank {shuttle} into the shuttle and launch carrying fewer than {threshold} infection.

carrier.name: CARRIER
carrier.verdict: You are off the ship. So is it.
carrier.how: Launch holding {threshold} or more infection. The medbay could have cut it out of you; hours you did not have to spare is why you did not.

overload.name: OVERLOAD
overload.verdict: The ship is a light, and nothing aboard it outlived you by long.
overload.how: Arm the overload on the bridge and survive the whole {fuse}-hour fuse.

relay.name: RELAY
relay.verdict: Somebody a long way from here knows exactly what is on this ship, and will not come looking.
relay.how: Broadcast from comms and hold the transmitter for {hold} straight hours.

specimen.name: SPECIMEN
specimen.verdict: You know what it is. So does everyone who will ever have to fight one.
specimen.how: Take the specimen from the ore hold and upload it from comms.

killed.verdict: It took the last thing you could still do, and then it took the rest.
killed.how: Every wound costs a capability for good. Run out of them and the run ends here.

adrift.verdict: The window closed with you aboard and nothing finished.
adrift.how: None of the four finished before the orbit ran out.
